choices: Full coin mold: one tiny plate accepted atomically, hard-hammer top strike stamps one material coin, item extraction and drop/replace preservation, two16x16 face bitmaps with unique flag, original shape/renderer and item configuration. CoinStampPattern owns all32 persisted short keys and actual Forge/Neo serialization/stamping. Native custom data writes commit copied tags, not detached mutation.

One placed ZPM artifact and all three existing source discharger IDs keep source block/energy/light/1-slot module/drop packing/control behavior. Capacity2e12 QU,131072 packet,15 light levels and20/40 packet buffer refill/clamps live in ZpmWorkRules and are actually consumed on both platforms. The source basic/elite QU and advanced EU mapping is retained, rather than registering a second donor family. brokestar has two QU/EU decharger rows and a richer shared battery-box/cover interface, masson offers explicit discharge-only arbitrary1..262144 packet extraction and a block/item carrier. Those wider interfaces remain candidates; this wave does not claim their complete absorption.

Fix the concrete ignored-active argument in source dungeon ZPM placement: original zpm(active) merely placed an empty entity, even for the pre-existing next2in3 true roll. Both platforms now initialize/persist full or empty charge from that roll through shared dungeonCharge and setChanged. Donor GT6ZpmItem documents the same two-in-three charged dungeon supply but migrates its trophy to loot; keep the existing full source block seat. This is code-corrected and compile-checked, not yet gameplay-tested.

Retain the entire source dungeon suite:28 dungeon classes including complete shared room/key/coin plans, normal/three-way/four-way corridors, piston door, entrance/pillars, barracks, storage, workshop, library, crop/fish/mob farms, bedrock mining and two portal rooms. Full DungeonLayoutRules owns lattice, independent dimensions, important room placement, scatter, path carving, both corridor cleanup passes and neighbors, seed/clearance; both platform bridges consume it with their original RandomSource. Forge original RNG consumption and IDs are retained.

Native rooms resolve existing actual material chests, safes, drawers, book shelves, crafting tables, molds, manual stations, scaffolds, pipes, hoppers, burning boxes, crucibles, tanks, dynamite and ZPM. DungeonBindings performs lookups/typed material selection only, registering no duplicate content. Full36 source dungeon/structure/portal files ported with necessary adapters; the marker structure and fixed-lattice placement codecs keep /locate aligned with the full per-cell feature.2 portal and17 flower pots registered, pot-content map joined in setup. Cross-dimension teleport uses native DimensionTransition, retaining nearest active matching portal, scaled fallback platform, key/igniter and cooldown behavior.

Compare complete donor layout and structure code: brokestar generates a square layout from one size roll and its piece enum lacks source portal room variants, while preserving many real room contents; masson serializes and clips a whole rectangular structure footprint but its shown room placement currently builds uniform shells. Its origin exclusion permits either distant axis and additionally forces the central cell, differing from source two-axis clearance/no forced-center policy. Keep source complete room gameplay and stable seed policy initially; whole-footprint structure ownership and exact GT6 alignment require generation evidence before replacement, not silent room removal.
knownGaps: Grouped dual compilation passes28s, then21s after charged-dungeon fix. No new subsystem test fixture; one ordinary Neo short startup is recorded separately.

Actual naturally generated dungeon completeness, cross-chunk farm ownership, piston doors, keys/loot/reward reachability and two-in-three ZPM discharge require gameplay evidence. Source feature catches room exceptions; server boot alone cannot establish room generation. Original anchor bedrock gate remains deliberately omitted by source per-cell design, and generated regions may differ from both donors/original GT6.

The source miniature portals teleport entities while original GT6 relays items/fluid/energy/redstone. Original relay delegates, particles and activation sound are absent; do not call the original portal system complete. Loaded-only target list, unload/reload behavior, fallback platform collision safety and player travel remain unverified.

Coin pattern editing availability, exact stamp display/material rendering, hammer damage, item automation and persistence are not gameplay-verified. Native provider/component migrations preserve existing keys but old-save compatibility has no evidence.

ZPM decharger elite duplicates basic source QU behavior and has no distinct tier policy. Source default block items use64 stack size; donors use16 or charged-single behavior. General QU item energy interoperability, cover UI, recipes, actual packet delivery and restart/charged items remain pending.

Both clients, Forge runtime, full survival chain, independent-process world restart, old saves, production jars and final release acceptance are pending. Original notices/author history preserved; third-party authorization unresolved, no publication. Full goal stays active.
